findings.explanation: verifySessionToken() ky token bang HMAC-SHA256 va so sanh chu ky an toan (dong 146, 159 - diem tot), va payload co chua truong het han 'exp' (dong 142: exp: issuedAt + maxAgeMs). Nhung sau khi giai ma payload, ham chi kiem tra payload.v !== 1 chu KHONG bao gio so sanh payload.exp voi thoi gian hien tai (now()). Do do session token khong bao gio thuc su het han o tang xac thuc: du cookie co Max-Age 8h, neu attacker lay duoc gia tri token (XSS, log ro ri, proxy cache, trinh duyet chia se...) va tu gui lai header Cookie voi token do sau moi thoi diem nao, verifySessionToken van tra ve ok:true vi chi kiem tra chu ky va payload.v. Can them kiem tra 'if (!payload.exp || now() > payload.exp) return { ok:false, statusCode:401, reason:'expired_admin_session' }' truoc khi tra ve principal.
